In open rhinoplasty a small incision is added in the columella — the strip of skin separating the two nostrils — which allows the surgeon to lift the skin and work with direct vision of the structures. This greater exposure is very useful in complex noses, in delicate work on the tip and in revision surgeries. The columella scar usually becomes almost imperceptible over time. The <b>Breast reduction in Girona</b>, a: The Breast reduction in Girona, also called breast reduction surgery, is a surgery of the Breast Aesthetic Surgery Unit that removes excess tissue, fat, and skin from the breasts to achieve a smaller, firmer, and more proportionate chest. When the chest is very voluminous (breast hypertrophy or gigantomastia), its weight causes physical discomfort such as back, neck, and shoulder pain, bra strap marks, or irritation in the inframammary fold. Breast reduction surgery therefore has a dual objective: functional (to alleviate those discomforts and improve quality of life) and aesthetic (harmonise the size and shape with the rest of your body). Like any surgery, it requires an individual consultation with the plastic surgeon.

Aesthetic rhinoplasty is usually postpon: Aesthetic rhinoplasty is usually postponed until the nose has grown up, generally from the age of 16-18; functional septoplasty can be considered earlier if there is significant obstruction, always with medical discretion. When choosing a surgeon, make sure they are a registered specialist with specific training in nasal surgery (plastic surgery or ENT, as appropriate), ask to see real-life before and after cases, and make sure the consultation assesses both aesthetics and breathing. You can do this at the Rhinoplasty Unit in Girona.
